# Fractional BD

> Fractional sales and business development leadership for technology companies entering or scaling in Canada, and go-to-market support for startups in the US, from Adnan Kichlu, a senior business development executive based in Toronto, Ontario.

Fractional BD places a senior executive on a monthly engagement in place of a full-time sales hire. Typical clients are early-stage technology companies and international companies new to the Canadian market, selling SaaS, AI, security, building technology, proptech and similar products to commercial buyers. In the US, the work is GTM strategy, lead generation and targeted outreach for startups, with coverage in Texas and California across manufacturing, construction, and oil and gas.
